adversarial_notes: EXIT misreport: every file was produced by one wrapper, '{ printf cmd; bash -c "$CMD" 2>&1; printf EXIT:$? ; }'. $? is read immediately after bash -c, so it is the command's own status and not printf's or a pipe stage's. Multi-stage commands (scope guard, nizamiq count, names cross-check) begin with 'set -o pipefail' so a failing producer (git status/git diff) cannot be masked by a succeeding consumer; the scope guard and the nizamiq count also assert non-vacuity (expected paths present; scanned-line counts > 0), so empty input fails rather than passes.

tail hiding earlier failure: the summary lines were never trusted alone. validate.txt was grepped end-to-end for FAIL/ERROR (none) and 16 PASS lines counted; fixtures_self_test.txt was filtered for any line not starting 'OK' beyond section headers (none; the FAIL tokens there are expected negative-fixture results prefixed OK); the convergent suite's FAIL/ERROR/skip lines were counted over the whole file (5/0/0), not just the tail.

grep matching a stale line: the nizamiq count is limited to hunk-added lines by an awk state machine, not a '^+' grep that could match '+++' headers or context. Frontmatter check cannot pass by parsing the wrong block: it asserts the opening fence, locates the closing fence (line 14), validates the Draft 2020-12 schema itself, and validates the parsed mapping. Two negative controls (mutating status to the out-of-enum 'accepted', and removing required 'version') fail with the expected ValidationErrors, so the check is not vacuous.

Scope guard: used --untracked-files=all so a new directory cannot be collapsed to a prefix, normalises paths (posixpath.normpath) so '..' traversal out of the evidence dir is flagged, anchors the evidence prefix with a trailing slash so a sibling like nip-0003-proposal-evil/ is flagged, splits rename 'a -> b' so a destination outside the set is caught, and fails on an empty list.
